name: Free Shipping Bar and Message for WooCommerce
author: Hastimal Shah

sections.description:
Free Shipping Bar and Message for WooCommerce is an excellent marketing tool that encourages customers to increase their cart value by displaying free shipping progress messages. You can display alerts as banners, bars, or icons in the header, footer, or bottom corner of your website to notify users about the minimum cart total required for free shipping.

Key Benefits:

  • Increase Revenue: Encourage customers to buy more to unlock free shipping.
  • Win-Win for Everyone: Customers love free shipping, and shop owners benefit from higher sales.
  • Fully Customizable: Tailor the shipping bar and messages to match your website design.
  • Lightweight and Fast: Optimized for speed and performance.
  • Easy to Use: Simple setup and customization with dynamic shortcodes.

How It Works:

  1. When a customer lands on the website, display a bar or banner showing the free shipping offer.
  2. If the cart total is less than the required amount, display a message with the remaining amount needed to qualify for free shipping.
  3. Once the customer qualifies for free shipping, display a congratulatory message.
  4. Optionally display a reminder message on the checkout page if the cart total does not meet the free shipping threshold.

WooCommerce version 3.0 or above is required.

Features

  • Display Free Shipping Bar with Progress
  • Show Free Shipping Icon with Progress (bottom right corner)
  • Display Bar in Header or Footer
  • Select Free Shipping Zone
  • Customizable Messages for various scenarios:
    • When a customer lands on the website
    • When the cart total is below the free shipping threshold
    • After qualifying for free shipping
    • Checkout page message if free shipping is not met
  • Shortcodes for Dynamic Messages:
    • {minimum_amount} – Minimum cart amount required for free shipping
    • {total_amount} – Current cart total amount
    • {remaining_amount} – Remaining amount needed for free shipping
    • {checkout_page} – Checkout page URL
    • {storepage} – Store/Shop page URL
  • Fully Responsive Design
  • Customizable Design to match your website’s branding
  • Lightweight and Optimized for fast performance
  • Easy Setup and Usage
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin and upload it to your WordPress site’s /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the plugin settings in the WordPress dashboard.
  4. Configure your free shipping settings, zones, messages, and design options.
  5. Save changes, and the free shipping bar will be displayed on your site.
sections.faq:
1. What WooCommerce version is required for this plugin?

WooCommerce version 3.0 or above is required.

2. Can I customize the messages displayed?

Yes, all messages are fully customizable, and you can use dynamic shortcodes like {remaining_amount} and {total_amount} for added flexibility.

3. Can I customize the design of the free shipping bar?

Yes, you can customize the bar’s design, colors, and placement to match your website’s branding.

4. Where can I display the free shipping bar?

The bar can be displayed in the header, footer, or as an icon with progress at the bottom-right corner of the website.

5. Does this plugin work on mobile devices?

Yes, the free shipping bar is fully responsive and works perfectly on all devices.
